implementation_audit.pairwise_scope: Uniform positive and negative draws within pooled batch; unbiased for that batch pair average, not guaranteed exact full-dataset pair risk because complete weeks are clustered.
implementation_audit.ranking_caveat: Pairwise logistic loss is an AUC surrogate, not direct empirical ROC-AUC optimization. BCE itself has ranking consistency support; RankNet is an empirical alternative, not a necessary correction.
implementation_audit.scheduler: mode=max; steps after current validation; export replays rates before each epoch. Default relative threshold1e-4 is an intentional scheduler convention, distinct from strict checkpoint score improvement.
implementation_audit.weight_decay: Both validation and fullfit read config.get(weight_decay,1e-4); exporter requires selected value match.
implementation_audit.monitor_scope: Frozen tree contribution is computed only for validation IDs, never passed to model or training loss. Every epoch records both metrics. Checkpoint best_epoch and standalone score refer to selected ensemble optimum.
implementation_audit.config_ablation_checks: LR-only differs solely in learning_rate; ensemble-monitor differs in early_stopping_metric plus monitor metadata.

distinct_formulations.idea: Temporal structured output head or CRF
distinct_formulations.why: Existing encoder sees complete inputs but terminal linear head/BCE has no explicit ON/OFF transition potential; many residual errors occur near switches.
distinct_formulations.feasible_discriminator: Before an architecture, test a predeclared weak temporal-smoothing perturbation on cached historical probabilities with case boundaries preserved. If both years decline, deprioritize generic persistence. If it helps, a two-state transition head with forward-backward ON marginals is a bounded next experiment.
distinct_formulations.limitations: Smoothing is only a proxy, not proof CRF will improve. Do not submit hard Viterbi paths for ROC-AUC; keep probabilities. Real short runs may be correct. No implementation in this lane.

distinct_formulations.idea: Spatial graph encoder for hydraulic topology
distinct_formulations.why: GNN/LSTM models are used in security-constrained UC literature to exploit network and time structure.
distinct_formulations.feasible_discriminator: First compare a small local/shared reservoir representation with existing fully connected per-hour inputs while retaining temporal encoder, rather than adding a large GNN.
distinct_formulations.limitations: Thermal/grid security UC papers optimize solver reduction/feasibility, not this hydropower competition metric; no claim their reported accuracy transfers. A graph rewrite is lower priority until simple optimization controls resolve.

distinct_formulations.idea: Classifier chains or auxiliary plant ON-count targets
distinct_formulations.why: Unit decisions have dependencies, especially multiple machines in one plant.
distinct_formulations.feasible_discriminator: Use predicted or chronological OOF upstream decisions only; evaluate an auxiliary count loss or small output refinement with fixed baseline as controlled model change.
distinct_formulations.limitations: Ground-truth neighboring decisions must never be inference inputs. Supplied labels violate simple unit-priority ordering, so do not impose ordinal unit constraints or exchange generator identities blindly.

augmentation_assessment.input_noise_or_time_warp: Deferred: arbitrary changes can cross deterministic commitment boundaries while original hard labels remain fixed. Reversing weeks also changes initial/terminal conditions.
augmentation_assessment.economic_scale_augmentation: Potential only if every objective coefficient, including start/stop costs, scales together; scaling price alone does not guarantee unchanged optimum. Case rescaling already addresses much of numerical scale variation.
augmentation_assessment.mixup: Possible regularization with soft targets, but interpolated weeks need not represent valid physical instances or optimizer decisions. Evaluate separately if simpler regularizers fail; not a physical invariance.
augmentation_assessment.chosen_first: R-Drop perturbs internal subnetworks while leaving original inputs and labels intact.

sources.use: Two dropout subnetworks with bidirectional KL consistency; hydropower benefit is hypothesis.
Pairwise probabilistic ranking loss trained by gradient descent.
Strongly proper losses including logistic have bipartite-ranking regret bounds under stated assumptions.
Decoupled weight decay is a separate regularization control for adaptive optimizers.
Validated mode, timing, patience and threshold behavior.
Representation interpolation is an optional regularizer, not proof of physical label-preserving augmentation.
GNN/LSTM architecture for spatial/temporal SCUC structure; a different operational objective from this benchmark.
Logistic, neural, random-forest and nearest-neighbor predictions coupled to feasibility recovery; supports distinguishing classifier quality from solver feasibility.
Predicted labels may condition subsequent labels; caution about train/inference mismatch and OOF construction.
Structured sequence-label probability model; considered as deferred hypothesis.

transition_control_proposal.status: Implemented and numerically checked; 2021 config uses the matched-budget monitor. Training remains unperformed by this subagent and may be deferred by root.
transition_control_proposal.scope: Consecutive hours1..167 within each complete case and generator; no edges across cases.
transition_control_proposal.hypothesis: Supervising temporal changes can reduce errors around actual switching without imposing minimum durations.
transition_control_proposal.why_not_ordinary_smoothing: Targets include signed ON/OFF jumps as well as stable hours, so true onehour runs are represented by both rising and falling transitions.
transition_control_proposal.probability_argument: For any fixed supplied input, squared error on y_t-y_previous is minimized by its conditional expectation E[y_t|x]-E[y_previous|x]. Thus true conditional ON probabilities jointly minimize BCE and the expected unweighted temporal-difference term; this does not assume conditional independence between hours.
transition_control_proposal.limits: Finite-sample fitting can still overfit rare transitions or harm probability ranking. AUC benefit remains an empirical hypothesis; predicted transition probability is not being estimated by taking differences.
transition_control_proposal.compute: No new model parameters, no extra forward pass and no additional randomness.
transition_control_proposal.protocol: Against round2_transformer_monitor_budget_2021: the same 39 epochs, patience 40, frozen ensemble micro-AUC checkpoint selection, architecture, seed and inputs. Only the stated loss, learning rate or weight decay intervention changes. The single intervention is transition_weight=0.2. Compare the frozen ensemble overall AUC and transition-region AUC; a promising 2021 selection gets confirmation with the epoch count fixed before 2022 evaluation.
transition_control_proposal.source_distinction: Signed temporal squared differences are a project-specific adaptation. Original gradient-difference paper uses image gradients; boundary-aware sequence paper addresses video action segmentation. Neither establishes hydropower ROC-AUC benefit.

comparison_to_smoothing.interpretation: Naive probability smoothing failed selection. Signed target-difference supervision is distinct because real positive and negative jumps are supervised rather than uniformly suppressed; its success is still unproven.

rdrop_readiness_review.implementation: Mean BCE over two independent dropout passes plus rdrop_weight times mean symmetric Bernoulli KL. Both pass graphs remain attached; inference is the ordinary deterministic model.
rdrop_readiness_review.normalization: BCE and symmetric KL each average over batch, generator and hour axes. There is no output-count multiplier. The config sets rdrop_weight=1.0.
rdrop_readiness_review.paper_equation_comparison: Paper equations 2–4 use half the bidirectional KL sum and the sum of two NLL terms. Our BCE averages the two terms, so weight1.0 corresponds to paper alpha2.0 in relative KL/NLL weighting, up to global loss scaling. This is a project convention, not a claim of paper alpha1.0 reproduction.
rdrop_readiness_review.sequential_passes: The paper concatenates duplicated inputs for efficiency. Two sequential forward calls implement the same dropout-consistency objective here; the Transformer uses LayerNorm rather than batch-statistic normalization.
rdrop_readiness_review.interpretation_limit: This compares the complete RDrop method with ordinary BCE. It does not isolate the KL contribution from averaging two stochastic supervised passes or changed stochastic draw consumption; that would need an additional two-pass BCE control.

runtime_estimate.basis: Two forward/backward branches per batch, unchanged one-pass validation; previous ordinary/full-fit timings and root planning estimate. This is not a measured completed RDrop runtime.

rdrop_readiness_review.priority_recommendation: One RDrop screen ahead of further RankNet, learning-rate or weight-decay sweeps, provided its selected-epoch confirmation fits before the15:01UTC reserve. Do not trade away frozen confirmation or verified export to add more exploratory fits.

evidence_narrative_for_final_report.status: Draft evidence summary at 14:33 UTC, not a final experiment status. Refresh against the execution ledger before delivery.
evidence_narrative_for_final_report.optimization: We matched the original 39-epoch training budget and selected checkpoints using the fixed ensemble score. The preselected equal old/new neural mean reached 0.988513 on 2021 and 0.987965 on 2022, versus 0.988272/0.987771 for the original reference. The 2022 run used the 37 epochs chosen on 2021. This supports the combined checkpoint-selection and blending procedure; it does not establish that greater model capacity was needed.
evidence_narrative_for_final_report.multitask: Using frozen plant blend shares to weight BCE produced a 2021 selected mean of 0.988649 at epoch 28. The weighted component alone need not have good all-head AUC: four unused plants receive zero direct loss. Confirmation with 28 fixed epochs in 2022 was still running at the review time, so a generalization benefit was not yet established.
evidence_narrative_for_final_report.mixer: The full-week Mixer completed both years, with 38 epochs frozen for 2022. Replacing the Transformer hurt both years, while the preselected equal neural mean improved the original ensemble to 0.988360/0.988135. This supports complementary prediction errors in this blend, not superiority of the Mixer alone. Architecture and parameter count differ, while inputs and optimization settings are held fixed.
evidence_narrative_for_final_report.rdrop: One remaining regularization control was prepared and mathematically audited: average two dropout-pass BCE losses plus symmetric Bernoulli KL. No completed RDrop fit existed at the review time. Its normalization is documented explicitly, and disabled loss/gradients/RNG remain unchanged.
evidence_narrative_for_final_report.validation_limit: All reported comparisons use repeatedly reused historical development years. Freezing 2022 epochs and blend variants limits additional selection but does not create an untouched holdout or explain other teams leaderboard scores.
